redact.title: Redact
redact.description: Replace phone numbers, payment cards, IBANs, US social security numbers (dashed), public IP addresses, API keys and tokens known by their prefix, and passwords, keys and tokens after a name like password= or api_key=, in each item's text, title and metadata (keys and values) with their kind ([PHONE], [CARD], ...) before memory keeps any copy, and in the earlier versions of an item sent again. Email addresses, names, places and street addresses are kept, and so are author (its handle and email too), id, session and about: send opaque ones where those are phone numbers. Each item's answer counts the placeholders its words hold, under `redacted`, absent when none. An item with no id is given a random one, so a retry sends an id or an Idempotency-Key. What memory already holds from an add that did not ask is not redacted: forget it.

Author.title: Author
Author.description:
Who said it. `id` is the caller's stable id for the person, the strongest thing memory can
be told; `email` and `handle` join them to the same person on a connector.

replacement.title: Replacement
replacement.description: What is true instead, kept as a note in this memory.

items.title: Items
items.description: Item ids, as they were added.

refs.title: Refs
refs.description: Refs of facts - the messages each came from, and all learned from them - or of excerpts - the whole conversation each is part of.

expires.title: Expires
expires.description: When this item is forgotten: from then no read returns it or anything learned from it, and every copy and every version is erased, as `/memory/forget` erases. Send the item again with the same `id` to move it, or with `expires: null` to lift it.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Only items that match: `author` (as sent: id, name, email or handle), `mentions` (`kind:name`, as `about` takes it, or `session:<id>`) and `metadata` keys, as {field: value} or {field: {op: value}}, in AND, OR and NOT; e.g. {"metadata": {"priority": {"gte": 3}}}. Metadata: eq ne in nin gt gte lt lte contains icontains, "*" for set. A filtered search returns facts and excerpts.
